about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots.sh mia captures for Tenshu Mia (`captured`, from the UI test in `uiTests`). Mia keeps no data of its own: the walk first fills the realm through Drive's, Calendar's and (iPhone only) Fit's own seed launches, then asks Mia questions the grammar answers from those rows (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §3g). `devices` limits a screen to the devices whose walk captures it. Settings is never captured: every row there is a "Coming soon" placeholder. Adding a capture means adding it here. Docs: docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §5.

01-welcome.shows: Chat before the first question: Mia's greeting and the question field

02-files.shows: A file search by name — "Show me my tax files" — answered with the Taxes folder and the tax return

03-photos.shows: Photos by time — "Photos from July" — answered with the holiday photos

04-calendar.shows: The calendar — "What's on my calendar next week?" — answered with the week's events

05-workouts.shows: Workouts — "Show my workouts from last week" — answered with the week's runs, rides and walks

06-history.shows: History: this session's conversation, titled by its first question

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh mia, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, light only, keyed android/phone/<lang>/NN-screen. The realm is filled first by Drive's and Calendar's own walks (store-screenshots.md §8.2). Same names as iOS for the same screen.
